notes: The filing refers to an annual Corporate Responsibility Report but also describes specific community and inclusion activities itself, so coverage is sufficient and no second look is triggered. The Item 7 excerpt mentions 'community' only in the SECURE Act's name (trap), and the 'Item 7 (targeted)' text contains no qualifying activities. The RIA insurance support desk is a distribution channel for selling annuities, not an entrepreneurship-enabling program. The described onboarding is 'more inclusive' but gives no specific inclusion practice beyond the general wording, so it is not counted for cross-cultural. The on-site solar farm is environmental and outside these themes.
